title: A header var never sees what happens per element
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
var seenSoFar = []
---
payload map (delivery) -> delivery ++ { seenSoFar: seenSoFar }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
var seenSoFar = []
---
payload map (delivery) -> delivery ++ { seenSoFar: seenSoFar }

explanation.approach: `seenSoFar` is computed once, before the map starts, and every element gets back the exact same empty value. A header var cannot accumulate anything as a map goes along — there is no hidden mutable state to update.
